description: Free URL submission through IndexNow: notify Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and other IndexNow engines that pages on your own sites changed. Needs the project's IndexNow key file to be live. Free; Google does not read IndexNow. For pages Google must crawl now, use force indexing (quote_force_indexing, paid).

urls.description: Up to 100 page URLs on domains that are projects in this account.

name: submit_urls_to_indexnow

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard page listing every URL submitted or checked from this account, with its latest index status. Share it with the user.

nextStep.description: Optional suggestion for the user's next step. Mention it once when it helps; never open it or act on it automatically.

label.description: Short suggestion to show the user.

url.description: Page in the user's CrakSEO account.

title: Free URL submission: IndexNow
